title: Transcat to Attend Upcoming Investor Conferences in November

body_markdown:
ROCHESTER, NY, November 2, 2026 – Transcat, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRNS) (“Transcat” or the “Company”), a leading provider of test measurement, control and calibration, today announced that management will attend the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference and 2026 Stephens Annual Investment Conference in November 2026. Transcat President and Chief Executive Officer Jaime Irick and Chief Financial Officer Tom Barbato will attend the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference and 2026 Stephens Annual Investment Conference in November 2026, where they are scheduled to host one-on-one meetings with institutional investors at each event. Mr. Irick and Mr. Barbato will also host an in-person presentation at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 11:25 a.m. Central time.


[Read the Full Press Release](https://www.transcat.com/media/pdf/TRNS-November-Conferences-PR-10-28-26-FINAL.pdf)
